_about: Biodes hand-off contract as read by Simitall and Bioana. Source of truth: github.com/nirwan1265/BioDesignGPT docs/SUITE_INTEGRATION.md and inst/registry/study_spec.schema.json. Add versions here when Biodes bumps handoff_version; never remove one.
_check_factor_names: Spec factors that are check entries: in augmented and p-rep layouts they share the treatment column with the test entries, so that column has entries + checks levels.
_main_plot_applied_to: Spec factor applied_to values that put the factor on main plots (split-plot layouts).
_satterthwaite_max_fixed_coefficients: Bioana: mixed models with more fixed coefficients than this are fitted with lme4::lmer (no lmerTest Satterthwaite df, which does not finish on thousands of coefficients); p-values then use the residual df (n - rank), stated in fit_summary.json warnings.
_count_assays: Which assays get counts.tsv is now decided by inst/suite/simulators.tsv (routes assay_rnaseq, assay_eqtl, assay_single_cell).
